_comment: Baseline values for configuration 1 (the reference config), captured from a verified end-to-end run. See tests/baseline/log.heleShawFoam and tests/baseline/alpha.air_t15 for the alpha-field baselines. The two new finger metrics (final_number_of_fingers, critical_radius_m) are computed by the alpha-field binarisation path (alpha > 0.5 + skeletonise + 3x3-neighbour tip rule), not the PNG path. The values here are for the alpha-field path; the experiment's PNG-based path gives different numbers (29 / 0.0057) because the two paths binarise different connected components.
